spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_dash.name: Blood Dash
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_dash.descript: Thrown the way you look, once more in the air before you land; looking up, a great leap. No fall damage till you've landed. (Also O.)
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_pound.name: Groundpound
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_pound.descrip: In the air: down like a stone. Everyone near where you land is thrown back and hurt, and every person near shows through walls for a while. (Also P.)
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_gaze.name: Blood Gaze
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_gaze.descript: A red laser out of both eyes for a second, exactly where you look: a Frost-born's beam in blood, hurting what it touches and sometimes taking or breaking the part it lands on.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.122: A vampire's Blood Dash, Groundpound and Blood Gaze, a second's red laser from the eyes, sit on the skill bar beside the hotbar.
